name: read-stub
description: On a full Read of a big source file, a System One model (Jev, or the open-source decider) decides per function/method/const whether to include it; the rest become stubs.

base_url.title: System One base URL
base_url.description: Serves POST /v1/systemone. Local decider: http://127.0.0.1:8000. Jev: TypeSafe's API base URL (as TYPESAFE_BASE_URL).

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' when set. Empty for a local decider.

keep_at.title: Include threshold
keep_at.description: p(relevant) at or above this keeps a symbol's full body.
